# Diffbot

Diffbot provides AI-powered tools to extract and structure data from web pages, transforming unstructured web content into structured, linked data.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/diffbot/.

## Actions

- **Diffbot Analyze** (read-only): Automatically determine a page's content type and route it to the appropriate extraction api.
- **Diffbot Get Event** (read-only): Extract event details from web pages.
- **Diffbot Get Image** (read-only): Extract detailed information about images, including dimensions and recognition data.
- **Diffbot Get Product** (read-only): Extract product information such as specifications, prices, availability, and reviews.
- **Diffbot Search** (read-only): Search data extracted by crawl or bulk jobs using dql queries.
- **Get Article Data** (read-only): Extract information from articles, including authors, publication dates, and images.
- **Get Diffbot Account Details** (read-only): Retrieve account details, including plan information and usage statistics.
- **Get Discussion Thread** (read-only): Extract threads of content from forums, comment sections, and review pages.
- **Get Video Data** (read-only): Extract information from videos, including titles, descriptions, and embedded html.
- **List Bulk Jobs** (read-only): List all bulk jobs associated with a specific token.
- **Resolve Lost ID**: Resolve lost ids in the knowledge graph.
- **Start Bulk Job**: Start a bulk extract job.
- **Start Crawl Job**: Spider a site for links and process them with the extract api into a single collection.
- **Stop Bulk Job**: Stop a running bulk job.
